chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Yaʿqūb, from Yaḥyā ibn al-Mubārak, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jabalah, from Abū Jamīlah, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār and Samāʿah, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
I said: The one who consumes usury after the proof has been established? He said: “He is disciplined; then if he returns, he is disciplined; then if he returns, he is killed.”

key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury, unlawful increase in financial dealings
key_terms.عَادَ: he returned or repeated the act

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a person who consumes usury after the prohibition has been made clear?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who consumes usury after the matter has been made clear to him. It indicates escalating punishment for repeated persistence in a prohibited act after clear proof has been established.
